## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game matching the five-world adventure and ULTITANKIST_RUT boss concept in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Worlds: Abandoned City (find keys), Digital Nightmare (defeat glitches), Forgotten Desert (find an artifact), Cosmic Abyss (open a portal), and the ULTITANKIST_RUT citadel (defeat the boss).
- Award one ancient artifact piece after each of the first four worlds; all four open the citadel gate.
- Boss phases: Normal Form with energy attacks and teleportation; GLITCH FORM with space distortion and digital copies; ABSOLUTE FORM with red energy and arena destruction.
- Include the boss’s final line and secret ending: “ULTITANKIST_RUT hasn't finished his game yet...”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions. User requested small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Continued from the existing Three.js game, preserving its existing presentation and mechanics while fixing progression and phase details.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed boss and glitch-copy cleanup between arenas and reset phase visual effects.
- Ensured new games reset game-over state and use the correct sector number in the signal toast.
- Updated world completion to award one fragment per world and only announce the gate open after all four fragments.
- Added the boss’s quoted final line to the ending overlay alongside the requested secret-ending line.
- Prevented re-activating already completed Cosmic Abyss portal anchors.
- Added CSS glitch/absolute visual overlays tied to boss phase.
- Verified `node --check src/main.js`, `git diff --check`, and HTTP 200 responses for the local app and JS module.
